// diagnostic E3516

Jet.GenerationRoundLimit

Step `{step}` would generate past the limit of {limit} rounds

What

Step `{step}` would generate past the limit of {limit} rounds

Why

Each round of generated Jet source is checked before the next round reads it, and a build generates in at most {limit} rounds, so generation always ends

Fix

Have a step read an earlier round's source, or merge steps of the chain so it is at most {limit} rounds long

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.GenerationRoundLimit: Tests/UI/GenerateRoundLimit/stderr.

Error: Jet.GenerationRoundLimit: Build plan is invalid: step `gen17` would generate in round 18, past the limit of 17: `gen0` -> `gen1` -> `gen2` -> `gen3` -> `gen4` -> `gen5` -> `gen6` -> `gen7` -> `gen8` -> `gen9` -> `gen10` -> `gen11` -> `gen12` -> `gen13` -> `gen14` -> `gen15` -> `gen16` -> `gen17`, each reading what the one before made
  --> Tests/UI/GenerateRoundLimit/run.jet:10:21
    |
 10 |             step: b.run("gen{index}", b.found(shell), [])
    |                     ^^^
 Why: Each round of generated Jet source is checked before the next round reads it, and a build generates in at most 17 rounds, so generation always ends
 Fix: Have a step read an earlier round's source, or merge steps of the chain so it is at most 17 rounds long
